content.text: The data shows F3_Z01's reported temp rose ~1.5-2°C above sibling F3 zones starting 2018-07 and stayed elevated, while setpoints remained flat. Critically, the VAV damper position setpoint for F3_Z01 jumped from 0.21 to 0.44 at the same time and stayed elevated — the controller is demanding more cooling air. A sensor fault reporting falsely-high would cause the controller to reduce cooling (damper closing), not increase it. The damper increase is consistent with a genuine local temperature rise, i.e., a local load change.
